stories.title: Three stores and a cold-chain account in a clean May
stories.recipe: Every bridge closes; each store account and the cold-chain account equal the GL.

stories.title: A chain transfer from Dubai to Abu Dhabi to Sharjah
stories.recipe: Sixty boxes go to Abu Dhabi and twenty-five of them on to Sharjah; neither is a receipt.

stories.title: A transfer between two lots in one store and one account
stories.recipe: Both lots sit in the cold-chain account: the transfer is neither its debit nor credit.

stories.title: The GL posts the same lot transfer gross
stories.recipe: The ledger posts the lot transfer as a debit and a credit: the closing agrees, the components do not (I4).

stories.title: A transfer sent in April and received in May
stories.recipe: The April transfer-out belongs to April; May holds a transfer-in with no pair.

stories.title: A transfer received under another item code
stories.recipe: Twenty boxes of 500 mg left and arrived booked as 250 mg.

stories.title: Box and box with a capital
stories.recipe: Units are compared as written (I1).

stories.title: Bulk dextrose in kilograms with three decimals
stories.recipe: Quantities to the gram; 250 grams spilled.

stories.title: A return of an April receipt that is in the file
stories.recipe: The receipt is April's and is excluded, but it is in the register: a valid origin.

stories.title: A customer return of a whole issue
stories.recipe: Forty boxes issued and all forty returned: exactly at capacity.

stories.title: Two returns on two receipts of one item
stories.recipe: Each return names its own receipt and stays within it.

stories.title: A return beyond its receipt in value only
stories.recipe: Ten boxes back at 2,200.00 against a receipt of fifty at 2,125.00.

stories.title: A return to the supplier citing a transfer-in
stories.recipe: Goods returned to the supplier must name a receipt, not a transfer (I5).

stories.title: A back-order opening where negative balances are allowed
stories.recipe: Two hundred masks were owed at the start of May; the scope allows it (I6).

stories.title: The same files where negative balances are not allowed
stories.recipe: The same bytes as H14 under the other scope.

stories.title: A rounding residue of minus fifty fils
stories.recipe: Nothing left in quantity and 0.50 below zero in value.

stories.title: A revaluation up with no quantity
stories.recipe: Gloves revalued by 150.00 with a zero quantity.

stories.title: An issue posted in June and one that happened in April
stories.recipe: The posting date decides (I2).

stories.title: The closing still counts the June issue
stories.recipe: The stock system closed May after the June issue.

stories.title: A movement dated 30 February
stories.recipe: A date that is not a date.

stories.title: A unit left blank
stories.recipe: No unit on one receipt.

stories.title: A Movement ID shared with a June line
stories.recipe: The June line is excluded, but its Movement ID still counts.

stories.title: An opening misposted between two GL accounts
stories.recipe: The GL carried 850.00 of Dubai's opening in Abu Dhabi.

stories.title: Credits swapped between two GL accounts
stories.recipe: Forty bags issued in Dubai credited to Sharjah; the GL total is right.

stories.title: A GL in another column order with padded values and an idle account
stories.recipe: Ordinary spaces around a value are not part of it; an idle account is still listed.

stories.title: A GL summary whose last column is Balance
stories.recipe: Not the GL columns: the accounts wait, the bridges do not (I10).

stories.title: Arabic store names and a GL in Arabic-Indic digits
stories.recipe: Arabic-Indic digits and the Arabic decimal separator read as Latin.

stories.title: Bahraini dinars with three decimals
stories.recipe: Fils of a dinar to the third decimal; a write-down of 0.125.

stories.title: A paged register in another column order
stories.recipe: Each page repeats the column row: listed and skipped (I10).

stories.title: Dimensions with a non-breaking space
stories.recipe: A space that is not an ordinary space makes the store unreadable (I8).

stories.title: Eighty positions across five stores
stories.recipe: Volume within the structure: one closing a unit short holds its account only.

stories.title: A closing booked to another store account
stories.recipe: Dubai's closing line names the Abu Dhabi account.
